eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Granite, MT; at 10:17 AM on AUG 30, 2026 Effective until 10:17 AM AUG 31, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: The Red Evacuation Warning for the Frog Pond Basin has been lifted. The area is now under a Yellow Warning Evacuation Advisory. Residents should remain prepared to evacuate if conditions change and continue monitoring official updates.
